All 4 scholars were present. After warm-ups, scholars were solving 2 digit addition equations, starting with the 10 blocks but then switched to pennies and dimes. After working with the pennies and dimes, Julianna was finding the sum correctly every time. Ester also felt more confident and benefitted working with the pennies and dimes to solve the equations. Lisa was able to self motivate and change her focus and attitude in a positive way.  This resulted in her completing more equations correctly than the other scholars.  Very proud moment for Lisa.  Faith was visually ill and couldn't stay focused though she tried.

Scholars attended late after seeing Santa.  After warm-up, scholars worked finding the sum of 2 digit addition equations, taking turns with solving the problem using 10-base blocks, breaking down 2 digit numbers, regrouping and solving and also straight algorithm solving. All 3 scholars are very comfortable solving the equation in the algorithm form but could use practice using the blocks and regrouping.  Perhaps try pennies and dimes with them.  Sarah is no longer in school.

After warm-up, Kenneth was focused, and eager to learn and demonstrate his skills.  We were adding 2 digit to 3 digit numbers.  Kenneth confidently used the counters then practiced regrouping. We also worked with a numberline.

After warm-up, scholars took turns regrouping with counters, breaking the numbers up in tens and ones and using the algorithm to add 2 and 3 digit numbers.  Ashley is confident with all three skills, Queen is gaining confidence and Wesley felt confident but was comfortable with more practice.

After warm-up, scholars used counters to add double digit numbers.  Faith needs to be reminded to carry the ten from rather than making it part of the sum. Ester is very comfortable with this skill. Juliana forgets to carry 10s and Lisa was easily distracted by the manipulatives and got possessive with them. This group of scholars had difficulty sharing manipulatives and respecting one another. When a routine has been established, please share to remain consistent.

After warm-up, scholars worked on regrouping with addition using counters and rods.  Mason and Johannssen were very confident without using counters, did several 2 and 3 digit addition problems, quizzed and checked each other's work. Jaida wanted to work more with the counters and the visual helped her recognize the reason to carry a ten.  Sarah is no longer in school.
Shortened schedule for choir. Played a 3 digit number game with <>= and the scholar enjoyed it, was confident and did well. We had time to practice some multiplication facts.  Only Kenneth.

Scholars warm-up was converting 3-digit number sentences into a 3-digit number using base 10.  Students need practice with this carrying the 1s and 10s over. This turned into a full lesson. More practice is needed.

Scholars warm-up was converting 3 digit number words into a 3 digit number using base 10.  Students need practice with this carrying the 1s and 10s over. Played a 3 digit number game with <>= and scholars enjoyed, were confident and did well. Sarah S. has left school.
